rationale.risk-routing: Composite independent risk scores trigger tiered allow, deny, sanitize, or escalation.
rationale.ai-review: Probabilistic safety classifiers judge proposed agent actions and payloads.
rationale.rules-based-checks: OPA policies deterministically evaluate thresholds, roles, contexts, and action invariants.
rationale.remediation-gating: Policy-selected sanitization autonomously transforms unsafe actions before execution.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Escalated actions remain suspended until an authorized human decides.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Runtime controls detect and block actions departing intended scope.
rationale.org-governance: Enterprise policy-as-code, ownership, enforcement, and audit form governance apparatus.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Architecture operationalizes EU AI Act, ISO 42001, and NIST requirements.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Tamper-evident persistent logs reconstruct actions, signals, policies, and decisions.
rationale.metrics: Defines and calibrates security, privacy, and compliance risk scores.
rationale.risk-security: Threat model and evaluated controls address injection, exfiltration, and tool misuse.
